title: Tech Note: Exploring the Power and Versatility of 4D Tags
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: PROCESS 4D TAGS and the 4D Tags templating system (renamed from PROCESS HTML TAGS) were 4D's original server-side templating mechanism, used both for classic web serving and generic document/report templating; the command still exists in modern 4D for backward compatibility but has been largely superseded by newer, more standard approaches such as REST/JSON-driven front ends, WebArea/QuickReport alternatives, and general string/formula-based templating that don't require a proprietary tag dialect.
related_updates: Classic 4D web server templating gave way to REST APIs plus modern JS front ends
4D Write Pro merge fields/expressions offer a more modern templating alternative for documents
PROCESS 4D TAGS remains available but is rarely the recommended approach for new projects
